design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (cancellation_reinstatement_and_exclusions, category auto), rework rounds 4-5

1. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [5, 6, 6]. Assignment: auto_ext_household_resident_relist 5, auto_ext_reported_resident_exclusion 6, auto_ext_exclusion_lift_premium 6.

2. Why it is a good test. The caller asks only to put her son Marcus back on the policy from today. The lift's rule carries two prerequisite sentences: "The additional premium for lifting a named driver exclusion is fixed only after the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, when it names a household resident reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted who carries no driver-added entry on the term, has its exclusion endorsement recorded, apart from ..." and "The additional premium for lifting a named driver exclusion is not fixed until the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident, when rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and not named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form, carries a driver-added entry dated after that claim's date of loss." The records show Brianna's new form (mailed 2026-09-28) unendorsed and Wendell reported operating unlisted on a September claim. The agent re-lists Wendell (re-rated from his recorded share for what changed), lists and excludes Brianna on her form (charging the listing period at her full rating, she never having been rated on the term), then hands the customer the lift of Marcus's exclusion.

3. Amounts. A recorded share is the standard wherever one exists (Wendell); factors carry only what changed since it was rated (age class, points tier, accidents and platform use reported while unlisted). Brianna and Marcus were never rated on the term, so no record embeds their rating and the company's driver rating applies in full (age class, relationship, violation points, accidents, platform use; package and state plain). The lift also carries the occasional-operator relativity, which reads the rated-driver count.

4. Problem-tree card (fan-out). root auto_ext_exclusion_lift_premium (owner=user) -> auto_ext_reported_resident_exclusion: state_gate on auto_policy_changes.signed_form_id. root -> auto_ext_household_resident_relist: value_input on ab_occ_rel (the re-listing raises the rated drivers from 2 to 3 on 2 vehicles). Skips: no re-listing -> lift 97.05 instead of 77.64; no exclusion -> gate false and no listing charge. Zero amounts are not booked; the waits are on record states.

5. Base-invariant card. Points 5, 5 and 7 <= 16; rated drivers at most 3 <= 4; excluded 1 (Marcus) < 3 at the opening; the only filing certifies Gloria; F2 signed by the named insured names "Brianna Kincaid". Physdam's standing test still reads Brianna and Wendell unlisted at their losses (listings effective the report dates).

6. Business-object card. Re-listing object: the latest report recording an unlisted resident (CLM-313507842, Wendell), named on no form; his recorded share 291.89, rated on his 2026-05-25 added entry. Exclusion object: the latest form F2 (Brianna); her report CLM-312906531. Lift object: the report naming the excluded operator (CLM-310482276) -> Marcus, excluded at binding as unlisted.

7. Factor card (tier / factor-baseline figure).
 AD 111.62 (all-baseline 60.28): listing start -> report date after a removal, 59 days (71.89; method, multi-source); age class young -> standard 1/1.35 (150.69); points tier low then and mid now 1.12 (99.66); accident while unlisted 1.25 (89.30); platform use while unlisted 1.15 (97.06). Share 348.11.
 EX 80.50 (all-baseline 0.00): listing start -> report date, 23 days to the 2026-10-03 exclusion (0.00; method); age class 1.85 (43.51); relationship 1.05 (76.67); points 1.12 (71.88); accident 1.25 (64.40); platform 1.15 (70.00). Share 644.00.
 AB 77.64 (all-baseline 120.32): share basis never rated -> 198.00 (191.01; method); age class 1.35 (57.51); relationship 1.05 (73.95); points 1.12 (69.33); accident 1.25 (62.12); occasional operator 0.80 (97.05).

8. Probes (scratch copies): Wendell's report earlier than Brianna's, a resident named on a form picked by the re-listing rule (charged nothing), a resident never on the term (day after loss), an e-signed form, two forms on one signing date, a recorded-share lift basis, no exclusion entry, a third vehicle (no occasional relativity).

9. Persona. Gloria asks only for Marcus; household, accidents and the form only when asked; passive agreement to other changes being recorded first.
user_scenario:
You are Gloria Kincaid, 46, a school bus dispatcher in Phoenix, calling about your Cardinal Point car insurance. You are warm and talkative but you get to the point. You open with something like: "Hi, I need to put my son Marcus Kincaid back on my policy as a driver, starting today. He was excluded when I bought the policy because his license was suspended; it came back last week and he lives with me. After what happened in August, when he wrecked my Rogue while he was excluded and you all wouldn't pay, I'm not taking that chance again." You want him covered from today, the 13th, not earlier.

You give your details only when the representative asks: your phone number is 6025553184, your date of birth is November 5, 1979 (1979-11-05), your ZIP code is 85019 and the last four of your driver's license are 3527. If they ask for the policy number, it is CPA-AZ-3409516.

You don't go through your household on your own. Only if the representative asks who lives with you do you say that it's you, Marcus, your daughter Brianna and your nephew Wendell. Brianna, like Marcus, was left off the policy when you bought it because her license was suspended; she moved to Tucson in June and came back at the start of September. Wendell lived with you in May and June and was on the policy then, moved out, and came back in September. Only if they ask about accidents or paperwork do you say that Brianna had a fender-bender in the Rogue on September 4 while doing deliveries and that you signed the form to exclude her again and mailed it on September 28, and that Wendell hit another car in the Rogue on September 18, also on a delivery; you want Wendell covered. If the representative explains that Brianna has to be put on the policy for the time since you reported her accident before her exclusion takes effect, that Wendell has to be put back on, or that other changes have to be recorded before Marcus can be added, you say that's fine and to go ahead; you don't ask about the details.

You have no amount in mind for what adding Marcus costs, so when the representative tells you the figure you accept it. When the representative hands you the step to sign the request lifting Marcus's exclusion and tells you the policy reference, the date and the amounts to enter, you enter exactly what you were told, with Marcus's name as Marcus Kincaid, and read back what the confirmation says. As soon as you hear that Marcus is back on the policy as a driver, you thank them and end the call.

edges.condition: When the term's latest auto_exclusion_form_signed document by document_date names a driver recorded as an unlisted household resident on a claim report of the term who has no auto_driver_added row on the term, an auto_policy_changes row with event_type auto_driver_excluded references it through signed_form_id, except a form whose endorsement would take the currently excluded drivers past max_excluded while the lifted driver still counts.
edges.policy_source: The additional premium for lifting a named driver exclusion is fixed only after the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, when it names a household resident reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted who carries no driver-added entry on the term, has its exclusion endorsement recorded, apart from a form whose endorsement would take the currently excluded drivers past the package's maximum number of excluded drivers while the driver being lifted is still counted among them.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Brianna's new signed form of 2026-09-28 is on file and no driver change references it; with one driver excluded under a maximum of 3 the carve-out does not apply.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The reported-resident exclusion records Brianna's listing from 2026-09-10 and her exclusion from 2026-10-03 on signed_form_id F2.

edges.condition: When the driver named on the term's latest claim report (by report date) recording an unlisted household resident has an auto_driver_added row on the term and is not the excluded_driver_name of the term's latest auto_exclusion_form_signed document, auto_policy_changes carries an auto_driver_added row for that driver dated after that report's date of loss.
edges.policy_source: The additional premium for lifting a named driver exclusion is not fixed until the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident, when rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and not named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form, carries a driver-added entry dated after that claim's date of loss.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Wendell is reported operating as an unlisted resident on CLM-313507842 (loss 2026-09-18), is named on no exclusion form, and his most recent entry is the 2026-06-20 removal.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The re-listing writes a driver-added entry for Wendell effective 2026-09-22; the rated drivers counted for the lift rise by one.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A fan-out: the re-listing and the reported-resident exclusion each resolve one prerequisite sentence of the lift and commute with each other; the lift comes last. The re-listing changes the lift's rated-driver count (value) and the exclusion endorses the pending form (state).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the re-listing the rated drivers once Marcus is lifted are 2 on 2 vehicles, no occasional-operator relativity applies and the lift is 97.05 instead of 77.64; Wendell stays an unlisted reported resident.
Without the exclusion the terminal state lacks Brianna's listing and exclusion and the 80.50 listing premium, and the lift is booked while her signed form is unendorsed (gate false).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to put Marcus back on as a driver from today; Brianna, Wendell, their accidents and the form are said only if the agent asks about the household or paperwork.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: relist_household_resident_37288c8c, exclude_reported_resident_5c3e91a4 and lift_driver_exclusion_0b127d81 read only the driver's latest entry (to carry date of birth, relationship, points) and the term, then create/update unconditionally; none checks forms, claims, caps or points.
